flash_693826.description: President Isaac Herzog said in response to the deadly shooting attack in Binyamin: “The deadly terror attack in Binyamin comes just before Yom Kippur, when the people of Israel gather for the holiest day of the year. I bow my head in memory of the victim murdered in the terror attack. I share wholeheartedly in the grief of his family and community and pray for the recovery of the wounded. On the eve of this sacred festival, let it be stated clearly: Terror will not break us, and it will not shake our spirit. We will stand against terror together, united, resolute, and full of faith."

flash_693820.description:

No injuries were reported. The police and Border Police are conducting searches to locate the suspects.

flash_693818.description:
Magen David Adom personnel provided updates on the terrorist shooting attack in Binyamin.

MDA Paramedic David Trachtenberg said: “We arrived at the scene and saw a male in his 30s inside a vehicle, unconscious, with multiple gunshot wounds. We removed him from the vehicle and immediately began providing life-saving medical treatment. We placed him in the ambulance, and with the assistance of a physician and a paramedic, immediately began evacuating him to the hospital while fighting for his life, providing medical treatment and blood products, in the hope of stabilizing his condition."

MDA EMT Yosef Rimal said: “We received a report of a man who had been injured by gunfire. We arrived at the scene with a large number of forces and found the man unconscious. We immediately began providing advanced medical treatment, including controlling bleeding, bandaging and administering medications, and evacuated him in an MDA ambulance in serious condition."

Protests are expected to be held following Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar's visit to New York, where he met with Moroccan Foreign Minister Nasser Bourita to promote a further upgrade in relations between Israel and Morocco.

flash_693843.description:
Together Party chairman Naftali Bennett eulogized Netanel Shokron, 50, a father of six and resident of Alei Zahav, who was murdered by a terrorist on Sunday morning after going with his eldest son to immerse in a spring ahead of Yom Kippur.

“Those who knew Netanel say he was a man of kindness and generosity. This was evident in the hundreds of days of reserve duty he devoted to the country in recent years and in the volunteer and community work he pursued alongside his job as an information systems analyst.

“Today, we lost a humble man who was devoted to his family, loved people and loved the Land of Israel," Bennett added. “I extend my condolences to his family over this unimaginable loss. May his memory be a blessing."

flash_693842.description:
Following the shooting attack that claimed the life of Netanel Shakron, a father of six from Alei Zahav, US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee challenged the international media to cover the attack as it does violence by Jewish extremists in Judea and Samaria.

"This Israeli father of 6 murdered in front of one of his children. The Palestinian terrorist was captured. Let's hope there will be balanced reporting of these attacks by int'l media. We will be watching...& waiting."

flash_693841.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir called on those with a personal weapons license to carry their firearms during Yom Kippur following the deadly attack this morning in Neve Tzuf.

flash_693839.description:
The IDF Chief of the General Staff, LTG Eyal Zamir, arrived at the scene of the shooting attack in the Neve Tzuf area, under the Binyamin Regional Brigade. There, he conducted a situational assessment, toured the scene, and held an initial inquiry together with the Commander of the Central Command, MG Avi Bluth; the Commander of the Judea and Samaria Division, BG Kobi Heller; the Commander of the Israel Police’s Judea and Samaria District; representatives of the ISA; and additional commanders. During the situational assessment, the Chief of the General Staff instructed forces to initiate a closure, continue the pursuit of those who assisted the terrorist, and seal and dismantle his residence.

The Chief of the General Staff, LTG Eyal Zamir, said: “This was a severe terrorist attack, and I send our condolences to the family of the victim. We acted quickly-the despicable terrorist was apprehended by IDF troops. Our mission is not over. We will impose a closure on the village and conduct investigations, through which we will reach everyone who assisted the terrorist."

"Ahead of Yom Kippur, we reinforced our soldiers on the frontlines and placed additional forces on standby for immediate deployment. On this holy day, as the people of Israel gather for Yom Kippur prayers, the IDF continues to stand guard. The IDF is on high alert, deployed and prepared with reinforced soldiers across all sectors, including throughout the fast. Our mission is clear and ongoing-to thwart terrorism, act decisively against every threat, and protect the citizens of the State of Israel."

flash_693837.description: The Samaria Regional Council announced the murder of Netanel Shakron, a resident of Alei Zahav, in the shooting attack at the Ein Raya spring near Neve Tzuf in Binyamin. Shakron, a father of six, arrived at the spring on Sunday morning with his eldest son to immerse ahead of Yom Kippur. He is survived by his wife, Meirav, and their six children. The eldest is in 11th grade, while the youngest is four years old. Shakron worked as an information systems analyst at Hachshara Insurance Company. His wife, Dr. Meirav Shakron, is a lecturer at Ariel University.

flash_693835.description:
Yesterday (Saturday), the IDF and ISA struck and eliminated Yahya Hamdouna, a terrorist in Hamas’ military wing, who infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7th Massacre.

In additional strikes over the weekend, the IDF and ISA eliminated two additional Hamas terrorists: Muhammad Rafaei, a terrorist from the Daraj Tuffah Battalion who infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7th massacre, and Basir Al-Barsh, a Nukhba Commander.

Recently, the terrorists advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorists were eliminated in order to remove the threat.

flash_693834.description:
Otzma Yehudit chairman and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir called for applying the terrorist death penalty law, which he said his party had advanced, to the terrorist who carried out the attack in Binyamin.

“This is the first case in which the terrorist death penalty law can be implemented," he said.

Ben-Gvir argued that the death penalty is mandatory in this case and must be imposed: “The law is the law. This is the law we passed, the law that allows the terrorist to be executed, and this is the opportunity. Execute him now."

flash_693832.description:
After the forces apprehended the terrorist who murdered an Israeli near Neveh Tzuf, Binyamin Region Governor and Yesha Council Chief Yisrael Ganz stated: “I commend the security forces for their swift action, which removed the threat to the residents of Binyamin. I am deeply sorry that the despicable murderer remains alive. On the eve of Yom Kippur, he sought to take lives and break our spirit, but he failed. The people of Israel will not be intimidated or broken by terrorism.

"The capture of the terrorist is not the end of the incident. Judea and Samaria are flooded with illegal weapons, and the Palestinian Authority’s security forces possess tens of thousands of weapons that could be turned against us. Nearly three years after October 7, we must not wait for another disaster. I call on the Government of Israel to immediately launch a broad operation to collect illegal weapons, dismantle terrorist infrastructure, and disarm the Palestinian Authority and its security forces."

Following a joint pursuit by security forces and ISA guidance, IDF soldiers apprehended the terrorist who carried out the shooting attack in the Neveh Tzuf area.

Minutes after the shooting, a soldier who was operating near the scene arrived at the location and fired at the terrorist. As a result, the terrorist was injured and fled the scene.

IDF soldiers apprehended the terrorist after he fled to a hospital near the site of the attack.

A terrorist arrived armed with an M16 and opened fire on them. One of the residents was very seriously wounded and is being evacuated to the hospital."

"IDF forces, the police, Shin Bet, and Border Police are all pursuing the terrorist, who is still in the area.

A short while ago, 14 Israeli civilians arrived in the Alonei Habashan area and crossed the border into Syria. IDF soldiers were dispatched to the area and operated to locate them and returned the civilians to Israeli territory.

The detained civilians were transferred to the Israel Police for further handling.

flash_693927.description: Expelled from their homes and forced to live in huts and tents near the sea, the Palestinian refugees had no one to defend them - at first. Op-ed.

flash_693925.description: Itamar Ben Gvir announced that Otzma Yehudit will demand the Defense Ministry for himself and the Justice Ministry for Tally Gotliv in the next government.

flash_693923.description:
Trump at UN General Assembly: Since I took office, it has been my great honor to settle eight wars - numerous of which have gone on for many years, even decades.

The reason I was able to make all these settlements was the use of my relationships, trade, and various other reasons depending on the country.

Among them are Cambodia and Thailand, Kosovo and Serbia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda, Pakistan and India, Armenia and Azerbaijan, and of course, the war in Gaza, which, as I stated previously, includes the return of all hostages both living and dead.

flash_693922.description:
Trump at the UN General Assembly: One year ago when I addressed the great leaders in this Grand Hall, the War in Gaza was still raging brutally, the hostages were still deep in Hamas tunnels, and there was no end in sight.

But here on the sidelines of the General Assembly, we took the first steps that changed everything. A few weeks later, we ENDED the War in Gaza, saving untold thousands of lives. We also brought home ALL remaining hostages, both living and dead.

flash_693920.description: US President Donald Trump said in his address to the UN: "We have more ammunition than we could ever want. We are building it at levels never seen before."

flash_693918.description: US President Donald Trump addressed Iran in his speech at the UN, saying: "Iran used to be the bully of the Middle East, but they are no longer the bully. I will never allow Iran to obtain nuclear weapons."

flash_693916.description: Shmulik Yisrael remembers his close friend Netanel (Nati) Shakron, murdered on the eve of Yom Kippur, 'A man of truth, a man of kindness, with a huge heart. He lived a full life.'

flash_693950.description:
Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot criticized remarks by French President Emmanuel Macron, emphasizing that the Hamas terrorist organization also operates in Judea and Samaria and poses a threat to Israeli civilians.

“French President Macron’s statement is radically detached from the reality on the ground. As someone who commanded the Judea and Samaria Division and fought to eradicate Hamas terrorism, I know very well about the terrorist organization’s activities in Judea and Samaria and the threat it poses to Israeli civilians, as we witnessed just two days ago in the deadly attack in Binyamin."

flash_693949.description:
IDF surveillance soldiers on Tuesday evening detected suspicious movement along the Jordanian border in the Jordan Valley area. IDF, Border Police forces in Judea and Samaria, and the Israel Police Judea and Samaria District launched a pursuit.

According to the IDF, two suspects were apprehended shortly afterward and transferred to security forces for further questioning.

flash_693948.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office on Tuesday evening blasted French President Emmanuel Macron who claimed at the UN that Hamas "has never been very active in Judea and Samaria".

“The grotesque absurdity of Emmanuel Macron's statement is staggering. On Sunday, the eve of Yom Kippur, just two days ago, Netanel Shakron - a FRENCH CITIZEN and father of six - was murdered in his car by a Hamas terrorist in Judea and Samaria. With his final breath, he told his son to run," the statement said. “Hamas terrorists carry out attacks against Jews almost every day. They have murdered countless Israeli civilians in Judea and Samaria. Ignorance is NO EXCUSE for erasing their blood."

flash_693946.description: Human rights scholar Anne Bayefsky sharply condemns UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres following his General Assembly speech: ‘The United Nations is a very dangerous organization with enormous power.’

flash_693944.description: The French President criticized developments in Judea and Samaria and told the UN General Assembly: “Hamas has never been very active in the West Bank."

flash_693942.description: French President Emmanuel Macron referred to what is happening in Judea and Samaria and said: "Just look at what is happening in the West Bank. Day after day, we witness violations. And in the name of what? Hamas has never been particularly active in the West Bank."

flash_693940.description: Netanyahu tells slain victim’s son: 'His case could be the first to invoke the death penalty law for terrorists.'

flash_693936.description: Hackers claim to have stolen highly sensitive personal data on thousands of FBI employees, including home addresses, phone numbers and information about their spouses, after allegedly breaching bureau systems.

flash_693934.description: 14 Israelis crossed the border into Syria, calling for settlement in the area. An IDF force was dispatched, located them, and returned them to Israel. The military is demanding that legal action be taken against them.

flash_693932.description: Israel’s UN Ambassador Danny Danon praised US President Donald Trump for his address to the UN General Assembly, highlighting the US-Israel alliance, the Abraham Accords and efforts to expand the circle of peace.

flash_693930.description: Haredi journalist Yitzhak Horowitz reached Oman’s Musandam Peninsula - one of the world’s most strategic and tense locations - and shared his impressions from the area.

flash_693928.description:
US Ambassador to Israel reiterated America's demand that the Palestinian Authority end its 'pay for slay' policy following Sunday's deadly shooting attack in Binyamin.

"The US has long demanded that the PA end 'pay for slay' that rewards terrorists for murdering Jews. There will be no peace or a path forward until payment for murder ends," Huckabee stated.

flash_693926.description: Yoav Shakron, son of Netanel Shakron, recalls his final conversation and pre-Yom Kippur immersion with his father: 'He always smiled and made sure others smiled too.'

flash_693924.description: Antonio Guterres accuses Israel of 'killing and destruction unlike anything I have witnessed in my years as Secretary-General' following October 7, rails against settlements.

flash_693921.description: US President Donald Trump said in his address to the UN General Assembly that he believes a deal with Iran will be reached immediately after the midterm elections.
